scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names cms,frontend --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm --prefix cms run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix cms run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix cms run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix cms run test
scripts.audit:prod: npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix cms audit --omit=dev
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
